I've pulled the grants ledger and the webhook delivery logs. Initial check: the grant event was recorded in the signup-events stream, but the entitlement write to the customer ledger stalled with a 502 from the entitlement service at 09:11:22 PDT. Reason looks like a transient upstream error during the distributed deploy window. No credits were attached to the ledger.

Plan:
- I'll manually apply the 1,000 USD credit to skylark-health (txn id: manual-grant-20260921-001) and update the ledger.
- I'll add a compensating log entry and open a bug with infra to prevent the 502 window overlap next deploy.

Diego/Marissa — I'll need a short confirmation email from the customer stating the org slug or primary signup email (so we have recorded authorization) before I apply the manual credit for audit.
